text: I had a great experience at this clinic! I just came for a mole removal, but was in and out within 20 minutes, very fast service, kind staff and doctor. They were very gentle with the anesthesia and the laser, I didn't feel a thing! They also gave me bandages and antibiotic ointment for aftercare, all within the quoted price given over Facebook. Would recommend to others for this service as well as others!

I went there for Botox and lip filler end of April 2022. The procedure was overly painful! I have had this done many times before. It should never be this painful. Even with numbing cream!
My lips and eyes was bruised for a week!
The Botox has worn off already after only 1. Month!
I asked for my lips to have a small amount as they were already full. They insisted I have 1 instead of half. They just want to make money! My top lip after a month looks awfully! I look like a duck as they put in too much. DON’T GO HERE! I’m thinking of getting an inspector out to look at their products. This practice should not be open!

This is the best Dermatological Skin Clinic in Koh Samui! The Doctor was really great, and the staff really took care of me.
Their products are also advanced. On top of Issara clinic being so POSH. Their clinic is also so clean too. Plus, they don't over charge their patients. I can't wait to be back.

Went for 20 units botox in my frown line between my eyebrows (glabella) and 5 units in my forehead. The doctor started to inject me before he even asked me what I wanted. I stopped him of course and told him. He didn't listen and went ahead and did 16 in my frown lines and 12 in my forehead which was not only wrong but also more than I had requested. Now 3 weeks later it is already wearing off so I assume he used a fake product.

I have found 90% of dr who do Botox, thread lift and fillers in Thailand are uneducated, bottom of the class graduates.   They are terrible at their job and know that most people they will not see you again.    Most never should have graduated beauty school
Have only good things to say about this clinic. Did Botox and the dr was very professional and had my best in interest and not making money. Will definitely come back :)

Great services, friendly and professional team, always good care.
The result is impressive!
The doctor gives great advice and professional consultation.
I appreciate the generous discount from Issara Clinic.
I highly recommend this place!

The best clinic in Samui. Very professional service. I did a lot of procedures there and I was always satisfied with the result. I live in Samui about 5 years and I am sure, they are the best in the island. All my friends agree with it.

This is an aesthetical clinic not a medical clinic be carefull! It should not even be called clinic but cosmetic shop.. actually the appropritate name should be "botox shop anyway whatever you have".
I called to ask for a skin check (preventive sun damage is important to prevent skin cancer in thailand!) and the operator said ok to all my questions and took the apointment anyway.. yes we have dermatogist and yes we do skin checks... When i showed up they  did not know what is a skin check.. though i wanted a skin tech! And the sharming lady in white dress at the counter trying to understand what i needed.. candidly asked me if i need a botox injection!!.. i could not stop laughing.. i met the doctor anyway.. mr whatever you need we have it.. young thai guy with a medical face mask to look more medical and less salesman trying to find something to sell me related to skin treatment.. he proposed me vitamin A and had no idea about dermatology skin damage obviously.. when he realised i was laughing looking at him like a clown he is .. at last he felt embarrassed and advised me to go to bangkok hospital.. he would probably be an excellent salesman in a cream shop though.. beware
I had a mole taken off my left cheek about a year ago they did a fantastic job

We went for a pimple extraction service. The staff were nice and polite, but...the service provider seemed inexperienced and unprofessional. They didn't extract all the pimples, some became more inflamed, and left very noticeable scars. (Previously, we had services elsewhere that didn't leave scars and extracted all the pimples completely.)

So, there were four of us here. Three had laser treatments, one had Botox, and everything was super easy and straightforward. They numbed everything beforehand. We're here for the second time today! And we'll definitely be back. Thank you 🙏🏾 …
I went to get a wart removed from my neck. The price was reasonable and the results were very good.
The staff were very helpful and the doctor gave excellent advice. I highly recommend this place.

The doctor was very gentle.
Very friendly. I really liked the service here.
